children: may retest resistance at $109.58 per barrel, a break above which could trigger a move toward the $112.14-$112.75 range.
A wedge is contracting to a point, which looks more like a bullish continuation pattern, to be followed by a resumption of the uptrend from $86.22.
The pattern will be confirmed when the market breaks $109.58. Before retesting this level, the contract may retrace moderately toward $106.02, as indicated by the wedge's lower trendline.
A break below $105.42 could confirm the wedge as a top pattern; a bearish target zone of $101.87-$102.85 would then be established.
On the daily chart, with the market approaching a resistance at $110.24 again, the dark cloud cover and a shooting star formed around this level look unreliable.
The contract is yet to fulfill a bullish target of $117.80, as suggested by a wedge. It is more likely to break above $110.24 and rise than to break below $105.88 and fall.
